_comment: Switchable instruction patches for Resident Evil CODE: Veronica X / BIOHAZARD CODE: Veronica Kanzenban.
The lifter keeps the sites of the version it lifts (title_id, from PARAM.SFO or --title-id) whose
current word passes the check, so one file serves every version and the launcher switch is the same.
Lift with: python tools/ppu_lifter.py JOGO/<TITLE>/USRDIR/EBOOT.elf --functions out/EBOOT.functions.json
A patch is on when PS3_PATCHES lists its name; the launcher also switches it live.
Sites from RPCS3's patches/patch.yml; the EU one is checked against our EBOOT (sha256 dd6628ec...).

patches.name: cv_door_skip
patches.title: Remove Door Animations
patches.author: Kapdap
patches.notes: The room-transition state waits on a 'door animation still running?' call; li r3,0 answers no, so the next room loads at once.
